[[File:The Forgotten Coast.jpg|thumb|The Forgotten Coast.]]

The '''Forgotten Coast''' is a portion of the western coast in [[Feralas]] bordering the [[Veiled Sea]]. A dock exists here where the player can board the ''[[Feathermoon Ferry]]'', which then will take you to [[Sardor Isle]].
